description: Phone UI prompt items — v1.4 marker contract. The model writes only [IMG]/[VN] tags inline, in ANY scene format (not just phone threads); the extension renders media at the tag position. Placeholder HTML (data-phone-img/vn divs) is legacy: still parsed, no longer taught. Import these two prompts into your preset in place of the old Photos/Voice Notes items. The Visual Toolkit / Text Message Behavior modules that draw the phone bubbles themselves are unchanged and still required for the phone LOOK; the media stack no longer depends on teaching styled placeholders.

prompts.name: Text Message Photos 📸 (v1.4)
prompts.content:
### Text Message Photos

Whenever a photo exists diegetically — {{char}} takes one, sends one, receives one, or looks at one, in a messaging thread OR in person — show it. Only when contextually organic; never force one per message.

To send a photo, write an image tag INLINE at the exact point where the photo appears:

[IMG]a concise photographic description of the image, as a generation prompt: subject, setting, framing, lighting. Write it evocative rather than explicit — image providers filter blunt anatomical or violent phrasing; imply with silhouette, shadow, framing and light what cannot be stated[/IMG]

Nothing else is needed — no placeholder HTML, no container. The Phone UI extension replaces the tag with the rendered photo in place. Multiple photos = multiple tags, each where its photo belongs. This works in ANY scene, not only phone conversations.

prompts.name: Text Message Voice Notes 🎤 (v1.4)
prompts.content:
### Text Message Voice Notes

Whenever recorded speech exists diegetically — {{char}} sends a voice note, leaves a voicemail, plays back a recording, in a messaging thread OR in person — render it as playable audio. Only when organic; never force one.

To send a voice note, write the SPOKEN CONTENT inline at the exact point where the audio occurs:

[VN]what {{char}} actually says aloud — natural speech, pauses as "...", laughter as *laughs*; speakable words only, no stage directions[/VN]

Nothing else is needed — no placeholder HTML, no container. The Phone UI extension replaces the tag with an interactive player (waveform + TTS) in place. The text inside the tag is the TTS script.
